messages.subject: Fall 2018 Meeting Time Poll
parts:
Hello D-RUGgies!

It's that time of year again to determine our Fall meeting time. Please navigate to the poll below and let us know when you're available. We'd also love to hear any topics you'd like to see covered this quarter, and whether you would be willing to present. Please fill out the form by Friday, August 31.
